command: python -m tests.benchmark.session_start_latency <project-copy> --label hermes-agent-1.27M --runs 5 --out <file>; v4.23.0 with its checkout on PYTHONPATH

store.source: the synapse store of held-out task 0cb3760383's hermes-agent index (bench/task_outcome/hermes-agent-test-ranking), built by v4.22.1: 474,232 synapse edges, all in the structural namespace
store.scaled_to: 1,272,023 synapse edges, the count reported on a freshly rebuilt hermes-agent index (337,346 nodes) on a 32-core Linux machine
store.learned_rows: synthetic: random weights and ages, so the export's content is not meaningful, only how long it takes
recipe_sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO synapses SELECT node_a||'#2', node_b||'#2', namespace, weight, activation_count, last_activated, created_at, half_life_days, learned_at FROM synapses WHERE namespace='structural';

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO synapses SELECT node_a||'#3', node_b||'#3', namespace, weight, activation_count, last_activated, created_at, half_life_days, learned_at FROM synapses WHERE namespace='structural' AND rowid % 3 <> 0;

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO synapses SELECT node_a, node_b, 'personal', 0.1 + (abs(random()) % 90)/100.0, abs(random()) % 12, strftime('%s','now') - abs(random()) % 2592000, strftime('%s','now') - 2592000, NULL, NULL FROM synapses WHERE namespace='structural' AND rowid % 20 = 0;

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO synapse_transitions SELECT node_a, node_b, 'personal', 1.0 + abs(random()) % 20, 1 + abs(random()) % 10, strftime('%s','now'), strftime('%s','now') FROM synapses WHERE namespace='personal' AND rowid % 10 = 0;
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO node_activations SELECT node_a, 'personal', 3, strftime('%s','now') FROM synapses WHERE namespace='personal';
DELETE FROM synapses WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM synapses WHERE namespace='structural' AND node_a LIKE '%#3' LIMIT 387789);

notes: hook_s: one fresh `neuralmind _hook session-start` process, start to exit, as the agent waits for it. done_s: from the same start until the detached maintenance process released its lock, or the hook's exit when none ran. Each run used a fresh APFS clone of the same scaled store.
